violations.text: The presence of rodents are not controlled as evidenced by droppings. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the storage shelf have an accumulation of droppings. New Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2026
The door to the toilet room is not self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 07/31/2026
The receptacle in the toilet room is lacking a cover. A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026

The floor and wall junctures in various locations throughout establishment do not have coving. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2026
The floor in the storage area is in poor repair (holes observed near column). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/14/2026

The presence of rodents is not controlled as evidenced by rodent droppings in storage area. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. PIC states they have monthly pest control services. New Violation. Correct By: 02/02/2024
Non-food contact surfaces of the chest freezer and reach-in freezer have debris. PIC disconnected chest freezer to defrost and clean during inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 02/02/2024
